edges.reason: msg.sender is read to derive the caller balance in myTokens.
msg.sender becomes _customerAddress in reinvest.
msg.sender becomes _customerAddress in withdraw.
msg.sender becomes _customerAddress in sell.
msg.sender becomes _customerAddress in transfer.
msg.sender is emitted as the distributor in distribute.
msg.sender is used for invested_ and holder accounting in purchaseTokens.
msg.sender is the from address of the external token pull, an untrusted caller entering the external call path.
msg.sender supplies the party whose tokens are pulled by erc20.transferFrom.
msg.sender is the recipient of the external erc20.transfer payout.
msg.sender indexes invested_ in getInvested.
msg.sender selects the dividend owner in myDividends.
block.timestamp is compared against ACTIVATION_TIME, creating timestamp dependence.
block.timestamp gates execution of purchaseTokens via the isActivated modifier.
block.timestamp is written into the onTokenSell event.
buy calls checkAndTransferMDX before accounting.
buy forwards to purchaseTokens after pulling tokens.
buyFor calls checkAndTransferMDX before accounting.
buyFor forwards to purchaseTokens with attacker supplied beneficiary.
distribute calls checkAndTransferMDX to pull the donation.
reinvest forwards dividends into purchaseTokens.
exit calls sell for the caller balance.
exit calls withdraw after selling.
transfer calls withdraw when dividends are pending, mid-way through its own accounting.
checkAndTransferMDX performs the external erc20.transferFrom call.
withdraw performs the external erc20.transfer payout call.
The timestamp gate controls whether purchaseTokens can execute.
sell multiplies amounts by fee rates through SafeMath.mul.
sell subtracts fees and balances through SafeMath.sub.
transfer computes the token fee with SafeMath.mul.
transfer computes net tokens and supply changes with SafeMath.sub.
purchaseTokens computes fee splits with SafeMath.mul.
purchaseTokens computes percentage fees with SafeMath.div.
purchaseTokens derives net dividends and tokens with SafeMath.sub.
purchaseTokens adds supply, balances and payouts with SafeMath.add.
distribute adds the donation to profitPerShare_ with SafeMath.add.
calculateTokensReceived uses SafeMath.mul on the spend amount.
calculateMDXReceived uses SafeMath.mul on the token amount.
The external transferFrom can hand control to a malicious token/caller and re-enter distribute before profitPerShare_ is updated.
The external transferFrom callback can re-enter buy while tokenTransfer bookkeeping is still pending.
The external transfer payout can re-enter withdraw before the caller's state is fully settled.
The external transfer payout can re-enter exit and chain sell/withdraw.
